map.按旋转体质量分布与转速估算稳定裕度，判断是否易失稳，用于舞蹈旋转、器械与舞台动作: Estimate the stability margin from the mass distribution and the rotation speed of a rotating body to judge how easily it goes unstable, used for the mechanics analysis and safety notes of dance spins, apparatus and stage movements.
map.单次旋转：由圈数与时长算角速度，判断旋转强度。: Single rotation: angular velocity from the number of turns and the duration, used to judge rotation intensity.
map.稳定性评估：结合训练水平评估稳定裕度，提示是否可控。: Stability assessment: judge the stability margin against the training level and indicate whether it is controllable.
map.眩晕风险：连续多圈累计角速度暴露，提示间歇与防护。: Dizziness risk: cumulative angular velocity exposure over many continuous turns, so interval the work and use protection.
map.：3 圈用时 2 秒 → 角速度约 9.4 rad/s；中级训练者稳定可控，初学: 3 turns in 2 seconds → angular velocity about 9.4 rad/s. An intermediate trainee can stay stable and controlled; beginners should start with single turns and limit the number of continuous turns.
map.柔韧性测试（坐位体前屈）百分等级: Flexibility test (seated forward reach) percentile grade
map.连续多圈易累积眩晕风险，建议间歇并固定视线点。: Many continuous turns accumulate a dizziness risk, so interval them and fix a visual anchor point.
